primary.claim: Shows pattern-level fitted radii and model-imposed geometric limits, not uncertainty of one common particle radius.

profiles.x: fixed base rounding radius r0 in nm
profiles.y: training log-MSE above the lowest tested/primary solution
profiles.semantics: Scale, local orientation and nuisance refitted; no confidence threshold or held-out selection.

regularized.radius: Mean of eight unweighted corner-cap sphere fits; model descriptor in nm.
regularized.prediction: Mean per-pattern log1p ADU MSE, same train/validation/test masks across stages; zero-based axis.
regularized.interpretation: Exploratory within-pattern validation; no physical radius confidence interval.
